# Rebecca Node 1.0.0

Rebecca Node 1.0.0 is the first stable release of the new Go-native node runtime. It provides a hardened gRPC control channel, independent per-node runtime management, accurate live usage reporting, managed HAProxy, and first-class VPN services.

## Highlights

- 🐹 **Go-native node runtime** — a consolidated gRPC-only control plane handles configuration, runtime operations, health, metrics, usage, and durable command delivery without legacy REST fallbacks.
- ⚖️ **Managed HAProxy** — install and apply HAProxy automatically on supported Linux nodes, route shared ports by SNI, HTTP Host, or HTTP Path, attach certificates delivered by the master, and serve node-specific website fallbacks.
- 🧠 **Independent node control** — each node can manage its own Xray runtime, users, Geo assets, auxiliary services, restarts, updates, and recovery flow while reporting its version, core state, health, and uptime to the master.
- 🛡️ **Safe reconciliation** — user-only changes can be applied without unnecessary Xray restarts, large configurations are supported, stale work is discarded, runtime operations are serialized, and interrupted commands are recovered safely.

## Traffic and access reporting

- Live online-user snapshots, including users connected without recent traffic
- Per-user upload and download speed reporting
- Inbound-level traffic attribution and batched usage collection
- Shared client IP and concurrent-session enforcement across nodes
- Session IP reporting and source-IP block controls
- Bounded online-IP collection and stable high-volume usage delivery

## Managed network runtimes

- OpenVPN with live usage reporting, reconnect handling, DCO controls, TCP server mode, and Xray-routed or direct egress
- WireGuard with persistent configuration, peer validation, DNS support, usage collection, and optional Xray routing
- L2TP, PPTP, IKEv2, and AnyConnect runtime management
- NAT, routing, quota, reconnect, and service-lifecycle hardening across supported VPN protocols

## Xray and outbound tooling

- Hysteria runtime users and safe user reconciliation
- Practical route, TCP, and ICMP tests
- Concurrent isolated outbound tests
- Managed Tor instances and GeoIP assets
- Psiphon exit-region discovery and managed proxies
- Managed Windscribe outbounds
- Runtime process cleanup, persistent API updates, and robust core downloads

## Platform support

- Linux binaries for 386, amd64, arm64, armv5, armv6, armv7, and s390x
- Windows amd64 binary for supported node operations
- HAProxy and system VPN runtimes remain unavailable on Windows because they depend on Linux services and networking facilities
- SHA-256 checksum files are published beside every binary

## Upgrade notes

> Upgrade the Rebecca master and its nodes together. Existing node settings remain in place, while the master can apply the new runtime capabilities after each node reconnects.
